subject: return spoons
body:
Aloha,

We bought 3 cases of the mixed color spoons and honestly the kids don't like them. We've opened 2 of the cases. Can we return those 2 for a refund?

Rob
Mountain Mama's Shave Ice, Provo
needs_human_reason: Clear policy answer (opened cases are never returnable, and it's past the 30-day window). The customer is polite, not escalating.
summary: Wants to return 2 opened cases of SP-MIX spoons (UQ-10310, delivered 1/22, 45 days ago). Not returnable; offered an alternative product and a free sample box.
draft_reply:
Hi Rob,

Sorry the spoons weren't a hit with the kids. Unfortunately we can't take those 2 cases back: opened cases can't be returned, and our return window is 30 days from delivery. Your order (UQ-10310) was delivered January 22.

If you'd like to try something more fun next time, our Color Changing Spoons (SP-CC) go from yellow to green and are $109.99 per case of 1,000. We can also send you a free sample box so you can see them before you buy.

The UNIQ Supply Team
assumptions: 'Aloha' is a greeting only. The shop is in Provo, UT (lower 48), so the sample box is eligible.
